note: Carlyle Lake, at the east end of the dam: the North and South loops sit in woods on a bluff above the lake. The Spillway loop below the dam has its own entry. Swimming beach, laundry and a reservable group shelter. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov record, rates, catalog and calendar read: USACE-run, 47 sites (North/South loops 1-32 on the lake bluff, Spillway loop 33-47 below the dam), all 50 A electric, water at South Loop 1-20, $20 all year (2026, 2027), 100% reservable incl. same day, 14 in 30, Spillway open year-round. Groups written manual; note cleaned. Waterfront: stored lakefront wrong -> recommend riverfront (Spillway 35/37) or lakeview; Spillway is a split candidate ~1.6 km from the McNair loops.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, not --AWH): DOWNGRADE recommended. No site is within ~50 m of Carlyle Lake over open ground: the North Loop (21-31, e.g. 24 at 38.613953,-89.336962) sits on a wooded bluff (3DEP ~158.8 m in the loop vs lake 135.3 m, pool 135.6 m) ~55-65 m through continuous canopy from the water; rec.gov photos of 22, 24, 26 show the lake only through trees: lake VIEW. The South Loop (1-20) is ~150-200 m back at ~144 m. The Spillway loop (33-47, centroid 38.61557,-89.35443) is BELOW the dam (3DEP 131.6 m, 4 m under the summer pool) on the Kaskaskia River tailwater (channel ~70-100 m wide on imagery): no lake value. There, Spillway sites 35 (38.61611,-89.354765) and 37 (38.615596,-89.355236) are ~21-23 m from the river over open lawn with the paved riverside trail and a riprap bank between (imagery 0.29 m/px; rec.gov photos of 35 and 37 show the river directly beyond the table); both are nightly reservable sites. Recommend RIVERFRONT with a caveat naming Spillway sites 35 and 37 (below the dam, trail and riprap between; the lake loops are lake view), or LAKEVIEW if the reviewer prefers the lake loops to define the entry. Lakefront should not stand either way.

SPLIT CANDIDATE: one recreation.gov facility (233786, https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/233786) but two places ~1.55 km apart with separate roads: McNair North+South loops, 31 sites + group area, centroid 38.61324,-89.33656, on the lake bluff at the east end of the dam; and the Spillway loop, 15 sites, centroid 38.61557,-89.35443, below the dam on the river, open year-round, no showers or dump of its own. No separate booking link exists (sites book inside the same facility).
